labels.name: Rain
labels.description: Rain streaks or rain-like directional interference.

labels.name: Blur
labels.description: Motion blur, defocus blur, or related loss of sharpness.

labels.name: Low illumination
labels.description: Low-light degradation with reduced visibility or dynamic range.

labels.name: Local occlusion
labels.description: Local anomalies such as droplets, water stains, strong specular coverage, or irregular occluders.

notes: Labels are non-exclusive and may co-occur.
Restoration-pair coverage is centered on RAIN, FOG, BLUR, LOW, and their combinations.
Definitions correspond to the versioned v1.0.0 release manifests.
